# @metator/plugin-git

<!-- metator:generated:start -->
<!-- Generated by `metator cards build` from the import graph. Edit the sections below, not this block. -->
- Directory: `packages/plugin-git`
- Depends on: `@metator/core`

- Used by: `@metator/runtime`

- Third-party: `simple-git`

## Responsibility

`Vcs` and `RevisionReader` ports on simple-git: changed files against a base, the repository's file list as git sees it, and file contents at the merge base.

## Invariants

- Renames count under both paths, so importers of the old path are affected [[cite: packages/plugin-git/src/git-vcs.ts:26 | "diffSummary([\"--no-renames\", ref.value])"]].

## Allowed dependencies

`@metator/core` and `simple-git` (ADR-0019).

## Pitfalls

- simple-git reports a failing git command without stderr as success; do not use `--quiet` flags (ADR-0019).
